label: Diagram: effect of removing a tax on soft drinks
alt: Two parallel upward-sloping supply curves for soft drinks: S1 with the tax on the left and S2 without the tax on the right, with a rightward arrow between them.
caption: Removing a tax on soft drinks lowers producers’ costs, so supply shifts right from S<sub>1</sub> (with tax) to S<sub>2</sub> (without tax): more cans are supplied at every price.
